gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link PaxDate#until(java.time.chrono.ChronoLocalDate)} returns a zero-length period when a date is measured against itself.
ADDED i2: A representative spread of Pax dates: the first/last days of months, the extra "Pax" leap month, century boundaries and dates in the BCE (negative-year) range.
